subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw keep a root Microsoft ecosystem tracker and PR-body updater as maintained repo automation, or keep this as an external/admin-only tracker?
rationale: The PR adds a repository-owned generated artifact plus a GitHub-mutating maintainer workflow, so the permanent owner and operating model need maintainer intent before repair or merge.

options.title: Keep After Guardrails
options.body: Keep the tracker only after adding check mode, safe PR-body sanitization, priority-label fidelity, proof, and removal of the release-owned changelog edit.

options.title: Narrow To Tracking PR
options.body: Drop the committed root artifact and keep the tracker as temporary PR-body coordination if the repository should not own the generated file long term.

options.title: Pause Or Close
options.body: Pause or close the branch if maintainers do not want repo-owned Microsoft queue automation.

recommendation.title: Keep After Guardrails
recommendation.body: Keep the tracker only after adding check mode, safe PR-body sanitization, priority-label fidelity, proof, and removal of the release-owned changelog edit.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the scoped workflow guidance that frames generated script ownership and is a plausible owner for deciding whether this repo should keep the automation.
